fixture: started-event(entered) + release-event 同步屏障 + watchdog(15s)；monkeypatch solver.solve，tearDown 保证恢复

cancel_levels.CANCEL_REQUESTED: GUI 置 threading.Event（主线程，即时）
cancel_levels.RESULT_DISCARDED: worker 返回时检测到 token → 不 emit solved/failed（结果不落地）
cancel_levels.COMPUTATION_EXITED: solver.solve 因有界预算返回（MCTS/Expectimax/Rollout 内部无取消轮询；最坏≈time_limit，MAX_TIME_LIMIT=2.0s）
cancel_levels.THREAD_CLEANED: quit()+有界 wait；超时转 retired，finished 后回收（无 terminate）
